chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: Racist men at the door and the fight
summary: Men tipped off by a dancer came knocking, called the girls nigger lovers and hit one; Bubbles grabbed a man and tripped his helper.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Now this boy was a dancer, he was the guy -- he didn't think much of negroes in the first place. He made you think he did, but he don't. Anyway he got the fellas in the lobby to tell them about the party going on and about Buck and I being there. So a couple of the guys, and they may have had a drink or maybe didn't have no drink or maybe smoking a reefer, who knows. They come to the door and knock on the door. Buck and I is in the room

where the victrola is. The girls is out in the room where the table for the food is all on. Buck and I are in the room where the victrola was and I am waiting to hear who's coming to the door and they found out it's a couple of strangers of the town that come to the door to knock on the room where there are no men allowed. They already know who's in the room, but the girls don't know they know this. So the President of the club goes to the door to see who it was. They wanted to come. She says, "You can't come in." "Why can't we come in?" "No men are allowed." He says "Buck and Bubbles are in there," he comes out with. She wanted to know how he knew who was in there. So he calls them, "nigger lovers" and he hits the girl. And I have moved from the room where Buck was into the other room where they were answering the door where the girls all are. And I'm going to see who this guy is at the door, after she gets hit. And the girls are there trying to get her up and fix her, and I'm trying to go to the door, and

one girl has got this arm and one girl has got that arm, they won't let me go to the door. I finally get away from the girls. I think they had an iron there, a smoothing iron, that the girls press things with. I think there was an iron there somewhere that I took this iron and I was going to hit this guy with the iron from where I was sitting. But anyway I didn't throw the iron, I got up and went to the door and just went all over the girls standing there holding the door and grabbed this fella. Now up the hallway, there's a guy waiting to help this guy that come down here. Well, I saw him up there, so he don't know I'm looking at him. He thinks I'm just here busy with this guy -- I'm busy looking at him, too, you know. So I hold this guy -- he comes down there to help this other fella. When he comes I took this fella I had and just swung around, fell down with this fella in front of this other guy and this guy fell on the both of us, you know.

So this guy don't know that I'm set on these things to do. He's set on going through the motions I was going through, you know. He was caught in the middle of his trap. Okay. So the girls got to get me up and get me in the house and let the guys get away from the door.
